Weekly self-review: Last Friday's stated change was: on the first live-overlay slot of each day, recompute every open seat's cushion from the fresh mark before any new BUY — do not inherit overnight/stale-bar ATR math. I followed it: stale-overlay mornings (including Tuesday–Thursday overnight and Friday 8:45) refused new BUYs and named the stale age, and the week's only fills (COST starter mid-morning Friday, CLS probe Friday afternoon) both cited live-mark cushions (~1.7–2.1 ATR) on a fresh Alpaca IEX overlay before the ticket, so the rule helped keep stop math honest. track_record.breakdowns is still total_trades 0 / anecdote on this reset paper book, so the week's audit is the open book — NOW day-10 (0.792 @ $135.92, mark ~$134.44, plan $125/$164/45d), plus Friday's COST starter (0.167 @ ~$914.40) and CLS half-risk probe (0.140 @ ~$383.88), cash ~$686 / equity ~$1,000, no forced exits. What went right: two honest seats filled on live overlay instead of another flat week, LNG near-miss was requalified to $262.00 instead of held unchanged, and Dell/HPE were not restacked on top of CLS. What went wrong: first act this evening died on a four-character new_trigger ($262 < 5-char floor) and a chart-file push race, and NOW's $145-by-~Oct-22 time-box is now the live clock. The one change next week: every requalify new_trigger must be at least five characters (e.g. $262.00 not $262) and I will dry-check len(new_trigger) before writing brain_response — next Friday grades whether any trigger_reviews gate fired on length again.
